lastCompletedStory.title: Wire fail-closed preflight at the run.ts orchestrator dispatch site

nextStoryContext: codexAuthPreflight (US-001, src/supervisor/codex-auth.ts) is now wired into all 4 worker-dispatch sites: the 3 supervisor sites from US-002 (loop.ts, review.ts, plan-runner.ts) plus run.ts's orchestrator dispatch (this story, the last one). This closes out the CAM-352 PRD's core wiring goal -- run.ts's setupPanes (previously void-returning) now returns { blocked: false } | { blocked: true; message: string }, threaded up through setupOrchestratorSession (which gained an optional blocked?: string field) to runRun, which on blocked prints `printError('codex auth preflight failed', result.blocked)` and returns 1 BEFORE its existing reset/created emitOk narration and BEFORE the sidecar/recycle-watcher spawn section -- neither the orchestrator nor the dashboard pane is ever respawned. A new optional codexAuthCheckFn?: CodexAuthCheck field was added to RunOptions/SetupOpts (destructured, forwarded to codexAuthPreflight's authCheck, defaults to the real ~/.codex/auth.json check when omitted, same DI shape as the other 3 sites). Gotcha specific to run.ts (not shared with the other 3 sites): it resolves backend via readBackend() (the GLOBAL scalar/[backend].name reader), never readPhaseBackend('orchestrator') -- a codex-backend test project.toml fixture must use the scalar form `backend = "codex"` (or `[backend]\nname = "codex"`), NOT the per-phase table shape `[backend]\norchestrator = "codex"` that readPhaseBackend understands, or the fixture silently falls back to the claude default and the preflight never fires. A partial side effect is tolerated on abort: ensureProjectSession may already have created the tmux session shell (2 cat-placeholder panes) before the abort point, but the existing CAM-47 isSessionStale reconcile self-heals this on the next cam run invocation, so no new cleanup code was added. src/commands/run.ts's file-size ceiling was raised 865->922 (scripts/file-size-budget.json, _ref updated) to accommodate the new blocked-result plumbing; no other budgeted file needed a raise. This was the last story tracked directly by the CAM-352 PRD notes chain (US-001/US-002/US-003); check prd.json for any remaining stories before assuming the PRD is fully done.
